description: This file defines extension methods for configuring AdoNet grain storage in an Orleans silo builder. It provides methods to add AdoNet storage as default or named storage with various configuration options.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring AdoNet grain storage in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage as the default grain storage, with options provided via an action.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use named AdoNet grain storage with options provided via an action.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage as the default grain storage, with options provided via an options builder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use named AdoNet grain storage with options provided via an options builder.
